# Run Event Types

Every event `loom run` writes to `run-events.jsonl`. This table and
`run-event.schema.json` are generated from one Go enum, so neither can drift from what the
executor actually emits.

Types that are *specified but emitted by nothing* are deliberately absent — see
`shared/telemetry/README.md` for that list and the roadmap item that would build each
emitter.

| Kind | Meaning | Fields beyond `at` and `kind` | Introduced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact.corrected` | A human edited a stage's output at a gate. | `stage`, `agent`, `gate`, `correction`, `diffPath` | L4.5 |
| `gate.approved` | A human approved a gate through a named channel. | `gate`, `approvalMethod` | L2.13 |
| `gate.invalidated` | An approval was reset because a bound artifact changed. | `gate`, `stage` | L2.14 |
| `gate.waiting` | The run halted at a gate and is waiting on a human. | `stage`, `gate` | L2.13 |
| `loop.exhausted` | A bounded loop reached its iteration limit. | `loop`, `stage`, `iteration` | L2.17 |
| `loop.iterated` | A bounded loop sent its span round again. | `loop`, `stage`, `iteration` | L2.17 |
| `policy.evaluated` | The policies watching a gate were evaluated; the run halts regardless. | `gate`, `reason`, `correction` | L2.16 |
| `posture.violation` | A stage changed the working tree without declaring a tool that writes files. | `stage`, `reason` | L3.30 |
| `run.completed` | Every stage of the plan settled. | — | M0.4 |
| `run.started` | A run began or resumed. | — | M0.4 |
| `stage.completed` | A stage finished and its artifact was digested. | `stage`, `sequence` | M0.4 |
| `stage.failed` | A stage returned an error. | `stage`, `sequence`, `error` | M0.4 |
| `stage.interrupted` | A stage was cancelled, leaving a resumable checkpoint. | `stage`, `sequence`, `error` | M0.4 |
| `stage.skipped` | The router routed around a stage the run does not need. | `stage`, `reason` | L3.0 |
| `stage.stale` | A completed stage was demoted because its artifact or an input changed. | `stage`, `sequence`, `staleReason` | L2.12 |
| `stage.started` | A stage began executing. | `stage`, `sequence` | M0.4 |
